title: Ambush Muay Thai

services.name: Trial Class
services.desc: Does Ambush offer a trial class?Yes, we offer a FREE intro class that is a semi-private session that teaches several Muay Thai fundamentals from the ground up as well as our class structure. All new students must do an intro class regardless of experience-level. We offer memberships with no enrollment fees and no contracts, our agreements are month-to-month with a 30-day cancellation notice. We also offer discounts for active military, veterans, first responders, teachers, and couples/families. What will I need for the intro class?For your intro class all you need are comfortable workout clothes. You may bring hand-wraps and gloves if you have them, we also sell starter gloves at our gyms.

explain.meaning: A first class to try it out before committing.

services.name: Ambush Muay Thai
services.desc: SPORT. Our kids program primarily focuses on youth sport Muay Thai as defined by the Muay Thai Development League (MDL). We teach techniques and strategies that can be applied both in competition and self-defense scenarios. SAFETY. There is no head contact in our training. Our coaches closely supervise training and all drills are performed with protective gear including gloves, shin guards, and vests. ADVANCEMENT. Traditionally Muay Thai does not have a ranking system, but we recognize that for kids it is important to have goals to work toward and rewards for accomplishments. blurb: San Antonio, & Cedar Park TX, our gyms teach Muay Thai & kickboxing in a community that’s welcoming to all ages & skill levels, focusing on strong fundamentals, conditioning, and practice. Muay Thai (or “Thai boxing”) is a martial art that utilizes the punches and kicks of boxing and kickboxing, as well as strikes with knees and elbows in close-range clinch fighting.
